f3_program: collection("party.attendees", "person", "late-night party", source("50 people at the party"))
observe(at("party.attendees.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("there were 50 people at the party"))

product_relation(at("party.total_contributions.amount", "current"), at("party.attendees.count", "current"), at("party.contribution_per_attendee.amount", "current"), source("each attendee had to pay $100"))
offset(at("party.total_expenses.amount", "current"), at("party.total_contributions.amount", "current"), -500, "dollar", source("the total expenses were $500 less than the total contributions"))
assumptions: The 50 people are the attendees subject to the stated per-attendee payment.

f3_program: collection("jeff_and_vicki.pencils", "pencil", "jeff and vicki", source("Jeff had 300 pencils and donated 30% of them. Vicki had twice as many pencils as Jeff"))

remove("jeff_donation", "jeff", at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "current"), fraction(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "initial"), 30, 100), source("Jeff had 300 pencils and donated 30% of them"))
multiple(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.vicki.count", "initial"), at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "initial"), 2, source("Vicki had twice as many pencils as Jeff"))

remove("vicki_donation", "vicki", at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "current"), fraction(at("jeff_and_vicki.pencils.jeff.count", "current"), 3, 4), source("Vicki had twice as many pencils as Jeff and donated 3/4 of his pencils"))
assumptions: The masculine pronoun "his" is resolved literally to Jeff.
